items.period: Shuowen seal-script style (modern vector redraw; not a dated artifact)
items.caption: Modern redraw of 也 in Shuowen seal-script style. It illustrates the graph named as the sound element in a reported old alternative spelling of 姐; it is not an image of historical 她.
items.alt: Vector drawing of 也 in a seal-script style.
items.selection_reason: The report of 也 as a sound element applies to an old alternative 姐 spelling. This image can illustrate that specifically scoped claim without implying that 她’s historical construction is established.
items.rights: The Commons description states the SVG representation is public domain.

limitations.text: No early artifact or manuscript image of 她 was established. The selected component image is a modern redraw and cannot document 她’s earliest form or prove the historical relationship to 姐.
